name: retail_net_revenue_dev
schema: CREATE TABLE customers(customer_id, verified, deleted); CREATE TABLE orders(order_id, customer_id, order_date); CREATE TABLE order_items(item_id, order_id, quantity, unit_price); CREATE TABLE refunds(refund_id, order_id, refund_amount);
question: Write one SQLite SELECT query returning net revenue for verified, non-deleted customers for dates from 2026-01-01 inclusive to 2026-02-01 exclusive. Sum quantity times unit_price and subtract refunds. Return one column named net_revenue.
rules: Revenue is item quantity multiplied by unit price, minus refunds.
Do not multiply refund amounts when an order has multiple item rows.
